headline: Move to Node.js 26.13.1
summary: The container image and CI move to Node.js 26.13.1, the current Active LTS line, and the server now requires Node.js 26.13.1 or later. Native installs must upgrade Node.js before they update to this release.

items.title: Run on Node.js 26.13.1
items.body: The container image installs Node.js from the `nodejs-26` package, 26.13.1 or later, on the 2026-11-20 `cgr.dev/chainguard/wolfi-base` digest. The server refuses to start on a Node.js release earlier than 26.13.1, including every 24.x release, and prints the required version. `package.json` `engines.node` is `>=26.13.1`. The OpenSSL floor is unchanged: 3.5.9, 3.6.5 or 4.0.3 or later on those lines, or 4.1 and later.

items.title: Native install and update scripts handle the Node.js version
items.body: `deploy/install.sh` installs Node.js 26 from NodeSource when the installed Node.js is older than 26.13.1. The Ansible playbook checks `/usr/bin/node` against 26.13.1, installs or upgrades Node.js only when it is older, fails if the version is still older afterward, and restarts the service when Node.js or the checkout changes. `deploy/update.sh` compares the new release's `engines.node` with the Node.js binary in `NODE_BIN` (default `/usr/bin/node`) before it restarts the service. When that binary is older, the update is rolled back, the service is not restarted, and the script exits with status 20.

items.title: Move GitHub Actions pins
items.body: The release workflows pin `docker/login-action` v4.8.0, `sigstore/cosign-installer` v4.1.3 and `github/codeql-action` v4.39.4.

items.title: Upgrade Node.js before updating a native install
items.body: This applies to installs that run from a git checkout under systemd, not to the container image. Upgrade Node.js to 26.13.1 or later first (https://nodejs.org/en/download lists the packages; `deploy/install.sh` uses the NodeSource 26.x repository), then run `deploy/update.sh` or wait for `hermitstash-update.timer`. The updater installed with an earlier release does not check the Node.js version. On Node.js 24 it restarts the service, the health check fails, and it rolls back to the running version with exit status 10 until Node.js is upgraded. Re-running the Ansible playbook upgrades Node.js for you.
